title: Cancel superseded pull request CI runs
body:
Product CI starts a new run for every push to a pull request branch and keeps the superseded run queued, so the two-slot self-hosted fleet spends slots on heads nobody will merge (2026-10-27: queue 7-23 min while GLOBAL, main and Product runs overlapped). Add the same concurrency rule GLOBAL validate.yml uses: one group per workflow and ref, cancel in progress except on main.
Acceptance: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` declares the concurrency group per ref with cancel-in-progress true for pull requests and false for main; `test/workflow.test.ts` fails without it.
